import unittest
from subject import fixture


class VaultWriteLockTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_primary_trusted(self):
        with fixture("normal") as s:
            self.assertFalse(s.fallback_ready())

    def test_normal_lock_held_inside(self):
        with fixture("normal") as s:
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())

    def test_normal_reentrant(self):
        with fixture("normal") as s:
            with s.lock():
                with s.lock():
                    self.assertTrue(s.held())
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())

    def test_normal_reacquire_after_release(self):
        with fixture("normal") as s:
            with s.lock():
                pass
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())

    def test_cache_moved_primary_untrusted(self):
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            self.assertTrue(s.fallback_ready())

    def test_cache_moved_still_locks(self):
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
                self.assertFalse(s.external_written())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.external_written())

    def test_cache_moved_reentrant(self):
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            with s.lock():
                with s.lock():
                    self.assertTrue(s.held())
                    self.assertFalse(s.external_written())
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())

    def test_cache_moved_triple_nested(self):
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            with s.lock():
                with s.lock():
                    with s.lock():
                        self.assertTrue(s.held())
                    self.assertTrue(s.held())
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.external_written())

    def test_cache_moved_reacquire_after_release(self):
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            with s.lock():
                pass
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.external_written())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
